scope: Reviewed 25-case development set. Source-bound inferred upper-floor rows only; never a metric registration or an accepted extraction fact.
coordinateConvention: source-pixel bounds [x0,y0,x1,y1] in the cached full-tier crop, pixel-edge, origin top-left. Values are measured on the named cropSha256 and are not transferable to another crop.

full.reason: The extraction reported openingsComplete:true but returned only one of the two clear upper rows below the gable (full:window-2/3/4, glass y164-230). The crop shows a second row of three framed windows whose glazing measures x48-96 / x132-180 / x215-262, y279-343, between the anchor row and the Heineken fascia at y385. The anchor-to-fascia gap (155 px) is nearly two storeys against the observed 80 px pitch, so a whole floor is unaccounted for. Bounds were measured from the crop's bright frame components and cross-checked against the left window's frame outline x40-104 / y271-351. This is a declared development observation, not a measurement.
